name: SceneId
meaning: Progress.currentScene (+0xb6) values and the arguments of Progress_GotoScene / Level_FinishScene transitions.

name: SCENE_LEVEL_n
meaning: disc level Lvl-NN (path Levels\Lvl-%02d\Lvl-%02d). Success goes to -3; level 0x10 goes to -4, level 0x11 to -5. Failure goes to -1 from level 0, else -3

name: SCENE_WHEEL
meaning: Levels\Wheel\Wheel (title/main menu). Entering it via Level_FinishScene runs Progress_Reset. Success goes to -3 if level 0 is done, else -2

name: SCENE_HUB
meaning: Levels\Scene\Scene; success goes to Progress+0xb7, failure to -1

name: SCENE_DEMO_A
meaning: Levels\Demos; on exit it goes to -1 and sets +0xb4 bit1 so the next demo is -7

name: SCENE_DEMO_B
meaning: Levels\Demos (same path); on exit it goes to -1 and clears +0xb4 bit1

name: SCENE_END_FMV
meaning: plays FMV list 0x71b318, then Level_FinishScene(0) gives -1 with Progress_Reset

name: SCENE_LEVEL_COUNT
meaning: Progress_InLevel: level >= 0 && level < 0x20 (SceneId doc: 0..31 = disc levels)
